subject: Pipeline integrity checkpoint & teach-back session

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline integrity checkpoint & teach-back session

Team —

Finance flagged inconsistent stage semantics across a set of mid‑to‑late deals during the monthly close. To reduce churn in next quarter's forecast I want to run a short "Pipeline Integrity Checkpoint" with a 45‑minute teach‑back for AEs and managers where we: 

- Align on the definitions: Commit / Best Case / Pipeline (what evidence we need at each stage)
- Walk through the audit template and a couple of real deal rows
- Agree on a 2‑week pilot to update records and measure movement

Agenda and ask: please update two deals you own (one Commit, one Best Case) in the attached pipeline-audit-template.xlsx and attach CRM links in the sheet by EOD Tuesday so we have material to review.

Proposed sessions (pick one):
- Tue May 25, 10:30–11:15 PT (calendar invite)
- Wed May 26, 8:30–9:15 PT (alternate)

Attachments: pipeline-audit-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Expected outcome: shared rubric we can apply to current forecast buckets + a list of deals for an immediate 2‑week hygiene sweep.

Thanks — quick and practical here. Reply with preferred time and confirm your two pilot deals.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for setting this up. Quick clarifying question: are we updating the definitions themselves (e.g., tightening Best Case evidence) or just aligning on how AEs apply the current definitions? Also, should SMB/volume deals be part of the pilot or just mid‑market/enterprise?

Happy to run the example rows — I can share two deals from my book. If you can drop a short example of a Commit vs Best Case row in the template that would speed things up.

Adding context and an example row — attached example-deal-rows.csv. In our playbook the difference we enforce is primarily evidence:

- Commit: signed LOI/PO, legal loops complete, Exec sponsor confirmed in writing
- Best Case: verbal buy‑in and budget confirmed, but legal/ops not started
- Pipeline: initial interest, discovery in progress, no budget commitment

I've filled two rows from my book in the CSV (one Commit, one Best Case) and included CRM urls. For the pilot I recommend focusing on mid‑market and enterprise only; SMB tends to be high velocity and noisy for this exercise.

Attachments: example-deal-rows.csv (CSV)

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thumbs up. Two operational asks:

1) Can SalesOps add a boolean flag on CRM records called "Teachback-ready" so we can filter the pilot deals quickly?
2) Can we surface a monthly commit vs actuals report for the pilot cohort so Finance can measure forecast improvement?

If you want I can pre-populate the Teachback-ready flag for the five deals I'm proposing. Otherwise I prefer the Tue slot.

— Jonas

Thanks all —

Quick answers: we will not change the definitions yet; the goal of the session is to create and lock a consistent application rubric (evidence checklist) that managers sign off on. Pilot cohort = mid‑market + enterprise only.

Jonas — SalesOps, can you add the Teachback-ready flag? If it’s low effort please set it for Jonas' five deals and Karthik's two examples once they’re in the sheet.

I've booked the Tue May 25 slot (10:30–11:15 PT) and added the drive doc with the teachback slides. Please update your two pilot rows in pipeline-audit-template.xlsx before EOD Tuesday.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=teachback-20270525
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=teachback-doc-20270522

Attachments: teachback-slides-v1.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate the quick turn on this — small lift, high signal for next quarter's accuracy.

— Rishi
